title: Age-dependent GGT and concurrent hsCRP: a negative incremental-prediction test across NHANES cycles
abstract: One age-by-log-GGT product added to flexible routine additive predictors yielded source grouped-CV MSE gain -0.000083 and frozen second-cycle gain -0.000411 squared log-hsCRP units (500 joint survey-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.004610, 0.000848]). The registered incremental-prediction criterion was not met. This is retrospective cross-cycle evaluation, not untouched external confirmation. Source n=4224, target n=3953; target weighted baseline/augmented MSE 0.753288/0.753698. This single-term result does not establish absence of age-dependent biology or clinical equivalence.
